triage.verifier_justification: The refutation attempt fails on the fidelity question: the §122 rule's own proof atoms are unchanged by this commit and cite membership-defined exceptions ("subdivision (aa)(ii) exclusion list under heading 9903.03.03", "7202.11.10", "articles of aluminum, of steel, or of copper ... provided for in headings 9903.82.02 and 9903.82.04"), while the pre-fix formula gated the zero on entry_is_line_a/entry_is_line_b — identifiers that name the hand-built witness's five exemplar lines and appear nowhere in the cited HTS text, so the encoded condition disagreed with the cited source in a chapter-61 (knitted apparel) instance under either reading of what entry preparation supplies. Where I do dissent is the kind: nothing about the entity (CustomsEntry), period, chapter scope, or output surface was wrong or changed; what was wrong is that every component gate rested on a fixture-identity flag with no grounding in the provision it implements, and the fix re-grounds each one on the membership its own provision defines (§122 exempt/§232 covered, entry_is_section_232_aluminum, china_301_list123/list4a/2024_action/solar, entry_is_section_201_cspv). That is the taxonomy's untraceable_branch ("a branch, condition, or value with no basis in the cited source ... the fix removes or re-grounds it"), with the wrong incidence population being the consequence rather than the defect itself.

triage.verifier_notes: inferred from verified sibling module index 60 (same kind and rule path in this chunk). Kind call is a near tie — wrong_entity_or_scope is defensible if "population" is read as "the set of entries a branch fires on"; I prefer untraceable_branch because the ungrounded identifier, not the rule's scope, is what the fix replaces, and the taxonomy reserves "re-grounds it" for exactly this. The diff is not single-kind: (a) brazil_section_301_component_rate and forced_labor_section_301_component_rate additionally ADD a missing list-membership condition the source requires (pre-fix applied the Brazil §301 duty to every Brazil-origin ch61 entry except exemplar lines a/b, with no listed-article gate) — that sub-change reads as unrepresented_clause; (b) the §201 edit is meaning-neutral (`if entry_is_line_e: 0 else: 0` → `if entry_is_section_201_cspv: 0 else: 0`, both branches 0); (c) the new ch61_s232_steel_heading_rate / section_232_steel_component_rate and its stack term are additive coverage the module never claimed (PR: "gain a Section 232 steel component the witness never had"), so on their own they would be enhancement, not defect. Exemplar coupling survives this fix elsewhere in the same post-fix file — entry_is_reciprocal_annex_excluded is still `formula: entry_is_line_a`, entry_is_reciprocal_metals_excluded still `entry_is_line_b`, and the IEEPA stack still carries `if origin_is_brazil and not entry_is_line_b` — so the module remains partly exemplar-gated; if the corpus dedups by defect, note this is one of 100 byte-identical generated chapter instances in commit a9562cfd44 (module index 60 of 100).
